grades.lower_bound_mechanism: symmetric-pair parity invariance (d±δ pairs), valid only for replies splitting every 2d-piece once
grades.notes: Conjectures c=(n+1)/(2n+1) — wrong; only n=1 value (2/3) correct. Parity-pair invariance is written for all n but only covers Xiang splitting each 2d-piece once; splitting the small d-piece instead beats Liu (n=2 gives 0.5), so claimed lower bound is unproven and false. Upper bound: no argument, ends at brute-force plan. Reduction used, never justified.
